order_note: After SQL 90 (it replaces aws_can_write_tenant(uuid), which the insert and delete policies call) and after aws/rls/sql/12_final_select_policies.sql, aws/rls/sql/24_complete_write_policies.sql and aws/workflows/sql/50_tranche5_write_grants.sql, which are already live. Independent of SQL 98 and SQL 99 in the database (SQL 99's trigger works under these policies). On production SQL 100 is a strict no-op: it records what production already has, so the production tool never runs it (an apply is refused unless the live state is already the intended fingerprint, production_state_already_intended, and then as already in place). In staging it is applied through the guarded executor (choice sql100-mortgage-desk-live-access) to bring staging to production's Mortgage Desk access.

tooling.note: Guarded tooling for SQL 100: sql100-mortgage-desk-live-access-production-apply.mjs --inspect (read-only) and the receipt-gated --apply on the engine shared with the staging guarded executor (choice sql100-mortgage-desk-live-access); production-sql-one-shot.mjs --migration sql100. intended_replacement_sha256 is the code-derived fingerprint (releaseIntendedHash in release-sql-state.mjs, equal to the staging pin's). production_noop: the production tool only inspects; its fingerprint includes every ACL entry's grantor (owner as owner) and each policy's comment hash, so a grant by another grantor or a policy comment (which DROP POLICY + CREATE POLICY would lose) makes the live state not the intended one and the tool refuses. The tooling does not authorize anything: this pin stays execute false until a reviewed change records the staging acceptance, the production inspect and an owner approval.

production_inspect.note: Pending: no SQL 100 production inspect has been run. Run scripts/deployment-guard/sql100-mortgage-desk-live-access-production-apply.mjs --inspect (read-only) and, for the detail behind it, scripts/deployment-guard/mortgage-desk-access-production-inspect.mjs (now also reporting function EXECUTE grants with grantors, policy comment presence and sha256, and column ACL grantors). Production is recorded when already_applied is true (live_definition_sha256 equals intended_replacement_sha256) and precondition_failures is []. If live_definition_sha256 differs (for example a helper with EXECUTE granted beyond PUBLIC and the owner, a grant whose grantor is not checksops_admin, or a commented policy), SQL 100 does not record production: stop and reconcile the file in a reviewed change. Never set execute true to make production match SQL 100.
